A '''mass-nulling clip''' was a type of portable transport device, primarily used by [[Scout/Legends|scouts]], that created a field of low gravity, enabling large loads of food and water to be carried on an individual's back or belt clip. Technology developed during the early years of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] allowed a single being to carry a week's worth of water.
